title: CLIPPER Thé Noir Bio - English Breakfast - Mélange d’Assam Corsé et Ceylan Délicat - 20 sachets
description: Description du produit Lancée en 1984 en Angleterre, Clipper est une marque de thé qui allie naturalité, éthique et saveurs. Plus qu'un simple slogan "Natural, fair and delicious" est le fil conducteur qui guide chaque décision de la société. Clipper, c'est avant tout une vaste gamme de thés et d'infusions conçue sans ingrédients artificiels ni OGM, mais ce n'est pas tout ! Engagée pour la planète, la marque Clipper conditionne ses produits en sachets non blanchis, sans plastique, biodégradables, dont la ficelle est en 100 % coton recyclable. Chaque sachet est emballé dans une enveloppe en papier, puis une boîte en carton recyclables et biodégradables. Le tout est fabriqué dans une usine neutre en CO2 qui recycle 98 % de ses déchets  ! Respectant autant l'environnement que l'ensemble des travailleurs de sa chaîne de production, Clipper s'investit dans le commerce équitable depuis 1994. Aujourd'hui, il s'agit du plus gros acheteur de thé équitable au monde. À elle seule, la marque soutient plus de 114 000 producteurs et leurs familles. Proposant des boissons de haute qualité, la gamme Clipper Tea se compose de thés concoctés minutieusement par de véritables maîtres en la matière qui créent des mélanges délicieux à partir d'arômes et d'ingrédients sélectionnés et assemblés avec soin. Pas étonnant que les boissons Clipper soient si bonnes et saluées par de multiples récompenses ! Le Thé Noir Bio English Breakfast de Clipper est un majestueux mélange de thé Assam corsé et de thé de Ceylan délicat qui, ensemble, forment un thé noir nature unique pour prendre votre petit déjeuner comme les Anglais. Labellisé Fairtrade et AB (Agriculture Biologique), il ne contient que des ingrédients naturels spécialement choisis pour vous offrir une dégustation riche en plaisirs. Il ne se compose que des ingrédients essentiels : du thé noir et c'est tout ! Poids = 44 g Ingrédients thé noir biologique Mode d'emploi Utilisez toujours de l'eau fraîche, versez-la sur le sachet pendant qu'il est encore en ébullition (100 ° C) et laissez infuser pendant 2 à 4 minutes Avertissement De Sûreté RIEN Voir plus
features: THÉ CLIPPER BIO POUR UN PETIT DÉJEUNER À L'ANGLAISE Le Thé Noir English Breakfast de Clipper est un succulent mélange de thé en sachet qui réunit l'Assam et le thé de Ceylan pour prendre votre petit déjeuner à l'heure anglaise.

RECETTE NATURELLE ET BIO Ce thé Clipper est fabriqué sans OGM ni ingrédients artificiels à partir d'un assemblage de thés provenant de l'agriculture biologique. Une recette simple et 100 % naturelle pour un goût exceptionnel !

ISSU DU COMMERCE ÉQUITABLE Première marque de thé équitable, Clipper offre un revenu juste, équitable et stable à ses producteurs de thé noir bio, en respectant et même en dépassant les prix fixés par le label Fairtrade.

description: Previous page Next page More Applications of UV Flashlight Previous page Next page How does a black light find pet urine? Why is some cat urine undetectable? description: Product Description Nordic Pure MERV 7 Pleated AC Furnace Air Filters provide good filtration for both home and commercial environments. Our MERV 7 furnace filters are comparable to HVAC filters with the rating of MPR 600. Nordic Pure furnace air conditioner filters are manufactured using a heavy duty, moisture resistant beverage board frame. The filter media is electrostatically charged to attract unwanted particles and will not promote the growth of bacteria or mold on the air filter. MERV 7 filters are better at trapping airborne particles than fiberglass filters. For fresh, clean air in your home and office, it is important to regularly change your AC filter to improve indoor air quality and help your HVAC unit perform more efficiently. We recommend changing your filter every 1-3 months, depending on your environment. People with pets or those who suffer from allergies should change their A/C air filters more often. Important Note: Almost all air condition filters have a different Actual Size (the exact dimensions) than Nominal Size (the name) printed on the air conditioning filter. It is best to measure the exact size of your A/C filter and compare it to our Actual Size to be sure your HVAC replacement filter fits. From the Manufacturer The Nordic Pure MERV 7 pleated air filters are made out of an electrostatically charged synthetic material that draws airborne particulates to it like a magnet. Electrostatic filters help trap airborne particles to protect your family from pollen, household dust, mold spores, and dust mites. With each pass through the pleated filtered, the air in your living environment improves. Nordic Pure’s synthetic filter media will not permit the growth of bacteria or mold, therefore, making your environment healthier. This air filter will capture other large particle contaminants to keep surfaces free of dust longer in your home. MERV 7 air filters are comparable to air filters with the MPR rating of 500-600 or FPR rating of Green. Particles in indoor air are measured in microns, which are 1/1000 of a millimeter. A human hair is about 70 microns wide. A MERV 7 Nordic Pure air filter captures airborne particles as small as 3.0 to 10.0 microns. This high performance air filter will outperform non-electrostatic fiber-glass filters, washable filters, and poly disposable filters. The MERV 7 electrostatic pleated air filter will help keep your air conditioning and heating systems running efficiently, saving on utilities and maintenance costs. The effectiveness of your air filter will depend on your environment. We recommend that you change the air filter every 30-90 days depending on the conditions in your home.

description: Counter or Fridge? Where do you keep your Butter? My name is Joelle and I’m the inventor of Butterie, the Flip-Top Butter Dish. Growing up I always thought butter needed to be refrigerated. My parents kept the butter in the fridge, and so when I became a mom, I did the same. What size drop do I need? Measure from the top of your vehicles receiver to the ground in inches Subtract fourteen inches from your receiver measurement Whatever drop length your calculated measurement is closest to should be your desired drop length. Round down if needed. How Do I Determine My Shank Size? The shank size should reflect the size of your vehicle's receiver. To ensure fit, measure the inside (wall to wall) of the square receiver located the back of your vehicle. Generally 1/2 ton are 2", 3/4 & 1 ton are 2.5", occasionally 1+ ton are 3" What is Tongue Weight and How Much Should I Have? Tongue weight is simply the downward force that the tongue of the trailer exerts on the hitch that is connected to the vehicle. For safest towing, a trailer’s hitch should bear a tongue weight between 10% – 15% of the trailer’s gross weight (GTW). How does Weigh Safe Help With Tongue Weight? The Weigh Safe hitch is the ONLY hitch on the market that accurately measures tongue weight using a built in gauge. Knowing your tongue weight can reduce wear on your vehicle, prevent excessive sway, and create a safer towing experience. description: Product Description Keep your engine running at peak efficiency while improving fuel economy. Engineered for today’s advanced engines, Mobil 1 Advanced Fuel Economy full-synthetic motor oil 0W-20 helps to improve fuel economy* and extend engine life for vehicles of all ages. Mobil 1 Advanced Fuel Economy utilizes Mobil 1’s signature Triple Action Formula to deliver outstanding engine performance, protection, and cleanliness to your vehicle. Specialty components in synthetic oil reduce friction, helping to prevent deposits and sludge buildup to keep critical engine parts clean and protected for up to 10,000 miles between oil changes.** This technologically advanced formulation offers outstanding engine efficiency, wear protection, internal engine heat protection (up to 500 degrees Fahrenheit), and low-temperature protection (to -40 degrees Fahrenheit)—bringing quick cold-weather starting and ultra-fast protection to your engine. Mobil 1 Advanced Fuel Economy meets ILSAC GF-6 standards to help provide low-speed pre-ignition (LSPI) and timing chain wear protection while keeping your engine clean and helping to improve your fuel economy. Mobil 1 Advanced Fuel Economy full-synthetic motor oil 0W-20 also helps control oxidation to prevent oil breakdown and is recommended by ExxonMobil for all types of modern vehicles, including high-performance, turbo-charged, and supercharged gasoline and diesel multi-valve fuel-injected engines found in passenger cars, SUVs, light vans, and light trucks. To learn more about the Mobil 1 Limited Warranty, visit Mobil.US. ***Source: The NPD Group/ Retail Tracking Service/ Dollar Sales/ PCMO full-synthetic/ 52 weeks ending September 30, 2023) Amazon.com Motor oil is made from crude oil and is used to lubricate, clean, and cool engines. Types of motor oil include conventional, synthetic, diesel, bio-based, hybrid (blends of conventional and synthetic), and recycled oils. Motor oil varies in weight and viscosity, as well as additives that some manufacturers add to the oil during the refining process. A numerical code system created by the Society of Automotive Engineers (SAE) grades motor oils according to viscosity--the higher the number between 0 and 60, the more viscous (thicker) the oil is. Most consumer motor oils are graded by two numbers, with the first number indicating cold weather (Winter or "W") performance.SAE 5W-30This oil has a weight of SAE 5W-30, meaning it has an SAE viscosity rating of 5 in cold temperatures and a rating of 30 at normal operating temperature. Always check your vehicle's owner's manual to verify that this is the correct weight of motor oil for your vehicle.Full Synthetic OilThis oil is a full synthetic oil, meaning crude oil is not used in making it. Synthetic oil can be used in vehicle engines instead of motor oils refined from crude oil, and often provides superior mechanical performance over traditional motor oil, including increased gas mileage and reduced engine wear at extreme temperatures. title: Beard Brush by ZilberHaar - Stiff Boar Bristles for Men's Grooming - Straightens and Promotes Growth - Works with Beard Oil and Balm - For Beard Kits - 6 inches long
description: A piece of luxury for your beard Made of a solid pearwood with pure boar bristles. Uncompromising quality from one of the most trusted beard brush brands. Made in Germany by third generation master craftsmen of brush making. The 4 Secrets of a Good Beard Brush Bristles are angledBristles go to the edgeWood is oiled (not lacquered)Bristles are uneven length A good beard brush has bristles at varying angles throughout the brush head In order to properly brush a beard, the boar bristles need to be tufted differently on the sides of the beard brush compared to the center of the brush head. A true sign of a quality brush is that the tufting has been designed for beard care. A cheap beard brush on the other hand has bristles at a plain 90 degree angle from one end of the beard brush to the other. Quality beard brushes have bristles all the way to the end of the brush head A sign of a quality beard brush is that the boar bristles have been tufted by quality craftsmen. The bristles have been inserted all the way to the end of the wood making for a full beard brush. Besides being a good brush making practice, it also assists you when you are brushing your beard in a mirror so you can see what you a brushing. A cheap beard brush often has a large gap between the edge of the wood and the bristles and is easily spotted when zooming in on the photos. Oiled beard brushes produce less static when brushing your beard A secret to great beard brushes for men is that the wood is oiled, not lacquered. This is because lacquered brushes creates static when brushing your beard. An oiled beard brush with boar bristles makes a lot less static. But doing it this way means that we can't hide behind the lacquer and use low quality wood. It also means our brushes need extra sanding and care. A quick look at a cheap beard brush and you'll notice that it is lacquered or painted. This makes it easier to use lower quality materials. Boar bristles on quality beard brushes are cut unevenly The purpose of a beard brush isn't just to straighten and shape one's beard. A beard brush is meant to reach the epidermis and exfoliate the skin. To penetrate through the beard and not just flatten it, the boar bristles need to be uneven. So in addition to the angled tufting mentioned in point one, this facilitates beard brushing and stimulates the skin. One can spot a cheap beard brush by the cut of the bristles. Flat top bristles push down the beard and reduce the chances of properly exfoliating the skin. 1. Bristles tufted at an angle 2. Bristles all the way to the end 3. Wood is oiled (not lacquered) 4. Bristles are cut unevenly Why brush your beard? As your beard grows the skin below your beard produces oils (sebum) to help the hairs grow. But the skin also replaces itself and needs some help to get rid of any unwanted items. Brushing your beard daily isn't just about making it look nice, it is essential to exfoliate your skin beneath the beard. Brushing your beard may feel harsh at first, this is normal your skin might not be used to it. But by doing it daily you will learn to love it. As you brush your beard you will activate the oil production on your face which in turn will help soften your beard. Keep brushing at least once a day (but don't overdo it either) you will clean your skin and beard. Look at your brush to see how much you are cleaning. Brushing daily promotes better and more uniform beard growth. Brushing your beard while growing a beard helps avoid ingrown hairs. A good beard brush is the best way to overcome beard itch. Made in Germany, by real artisans Pearwood timber is checked and cut The pearwood timber waits up to 8 weeks before being cut and then milled into brush handles. Each board checked for impurities or possible cracks. Milled brush handles are sanded Once milled the brush handles are sanded to remove any ridges and get the finish just right so they can then be oiled and laser etched. Natural boar bristles are trimmed The natural boar bristles are sorted into bundles based on thickness and length, they are then trimmed to get the right size for the brushes. Tufted beard brushes are tested Once the oiled and etched handles are ready they are tufted with the boar bristles. Each one then gets a quick "shave" to remove any bad bristles. After which they go for quality control. Desktop studio monitor stands are specifically designed supports or platforms used to elevate and position studio monitors or speakers on a desk or workspace. These stands offer several practical advantages and serve multiple purposes in professional audio production or home recording setups. Improved Sound Quality: Placing studio monitors on desktop stands helps optimize sound quality by providing proper positioning and alignment. The stands allow you to position the monitors at the ideal height and angle, ensuring that the sound waves are directed towards your ears at the optimal listening position. This helps to minimize audio reflections and enhances the accuracy of audio monitoring, allowing you to make more informed decisions during the mixing and mastering process.Reduced Resonance and Vibration: Desktop stands are often designed with materials that help reduce resonance and vibration. By isolating the monitors from the desk surface, these stands minimize the transfer of unwanted vibrations that can affect the clarity and accuracy of the audio playback. This is particularly important when working with low-frequency sounds, as it helps to prevent bass frequencies from being muddied or distorted.Ergonomic Considerations: Using monitor stands also provides ergonomic benefits. By elevating the studio monitors to ear level, they help promote better posture and reduce strain on the neck and back. This is particularly important during long recording or mixing sessions, as it minimizes fatigue and discomfort, allowing you to work more comfortably and efficiently.Space Optimization: Desktop monitor stands help optimize desk space by providing a designated area for your studio monitors. By lifting the monitors off the desk, you free up valuable workspace that can be utilized for other equipment or tasks. This is especially beneficial in smaller studio environments or home recording setups where space is limited.Cable Management: Many monitor stands feature integrated cable management solutions. These allow you to route and organize the audio cables and power cords neatly, preventing tangles and creating a cleaner and more organized workspace. Proper cable management not only improves aesthetics but also reduces the risk of accidental disconnections or damage to cables. description: Product Description EAST OAK Compost Tumbler is here to make composting easy for beginners and seasoned green thumbs alike! Mature compost can be used as fertilizer for growing flowers, plants, and vegetables. Organic fertilizers help improve soil quality and promote plant growth.Storage environment: Position: Place the compost in a well-ventilated place with sufficient sunlight but not overheating, preferably in the yard or in a corner of the garden.Humidity: Keep the compost properly humidity, compost should remain wet but not too wet. In dry weather, regular watering required to maintain proper humidity.How to use:Add scraps: Open the door and add scraps, load them with waste from yard and kitchen. Then give them time to heat up. Turning a compost pile mixing the organic materials and the organisms it contains with heat-producing oxygen is the traditional method of keeping the process going full steam.Turn the tumbler: All you need to do is turn the tumbler every 5-6 times every few days, the organic materials will mixed and infused with fresh oxygen. Finally you will get rich, fertile compost in just 4-6 weeks or less in hot weather!Usage tips:Too much scraps: Avoid adding too much organic waste to compost all at once, which may result in compost being too dense and lack of oxygen, thus affecting decomposition efficiency.Minimize the scraps: Try to chop or tear organic waste into small pieces before adding it to the compost bucket. This helps to speed up the decomposition process, and can reduce the volume of waste in the compost.Layer upon layer stacked: Stack different types of organic waste instead of mixing them together. For example, you can put a layer of kitchen waste, then a layer of carbon source materials such as dead leaves or lawn pruning, and then add some soil or composting starter (if you have) to promote decomposition.Smell: Normally, compost should produce a earth-like smell. If there is a bad smell, the composting may be too wet or contain inappropriate substances, so you need to adjust it appropriately, add more carbon source materials or adjust the proportion of composting. The modified drop-point blade makes it a good slicing knife, while the slim tip gives it excellent piercing and detail work capabilities. The cool stonewash blade finish does more than look good, it also hides scratches from daily wear and tear. You can look to Kershaw for everyday carrying knives that can tame any cardboard box and liberate any purchase from its plastic packaging, sporting knives that make hunting, fishing, watersports, and camping even better, work knives that won’t let you down, and tactical knives that ensure you’re ready for anything. Flipper: A protrusion on the back of the blade that the user can pull back on, or flip, in order to move the blade easily out of the handle. Speed Safe: Assists you to open any Speed Safe knife quickly and easily with a manual push on the thumb stud or pull back on the flipper. Frame Lock: A portion of the handle (the knife frame) moves behind the blade to lock it into position during use. Reversible: Enables the user to change either the tip position or the side on which the knife carries.

description: MARTELLI-Rotary Cutter. This 45mm rotary cutter can cut up to fifteen layers at a time without stress on hand and wrist. features: ERGONOMIC DESIGN Unlike other rotary cutters, the Martelli rotary cutter has a stylish unique design that promotes proper finger placement and feels good in your hand. It has a doughroller type design and is meant to be pushed forward in a similar motion allowing the cutter to do the work for you. Unlike other rotary cutters that require you to apply pressure downward as you cut and can cause wrist pain our cutter does the work for you with minimal pressure which means minimal pain!

SUPERIOR BLADES Our rotary cutter comes equipped with a super sharp blade made with the highest quality metal alloy in the industry; tungsten steel. Our blades are sharpened on both sides simultaneously, so the blade comes down to an even point and cuts through fabric with ease. They last 3-5 times longer than ordinary blades and cut through multiple types of fabrics such as cotton, batik, linen, silk, polyester, denim, wool, vinyl, fleece, flannel, and more! Easy blade replacement with YouTube tutorial video. Just search "Martelli ERGO Rotary Cutter Assembly."

SAFE TO USE All Martelli rotary cutters have spring loaded guards used to expose or hide the blade. The ability to hide the blade while the cutter is not in use prevents harm to the user, children, pets, etc. while also protecting the blade itself from damage. ALWAYS MAKE SURE THE BLADE IS COVERED WHILE THE CUTTER IS NOT IN USE!

HAND PREFERENCE It doesn’t matter if you’re right handed or left handed. We make rotary cutters with everyone in mind! Right handed cutters come with a red rubber comfort grip handle and left handed cutters come with a blue rubber comfort grip handle. WHEN ORDERING PLEASE CONFIRM WHETHER YOU ARE ORDERING A RIGHT HANDED OR LEFT HANDED CUTTER.

SIZE OPTIONS Our rotary cutters come in three sizes 28mm, 45mm, and 60mm. The 45mm is our most popular option and is for general fabric cutting. The 28mm rotary cutter has the smallest blade and is used for more intricate cutting and minimal layers. The 60mm rotary cutter holds our largest blade and can cut as many as 6-8 layers of fabric at once.
